issues.problem: cd-volition mistake 授業が終われば、図書館へ行きましょう has different subjects in A and B (the guide's own stated exception), so the 'bad' sentence is not plainly wrong.
issues.action: Replaced with same-subject 日本に着けば、連絡してください ✗ / 着いたら ✓.

issues.problem: cd-regret explain claimed ならよかった is never used for regret; after nouns and な-adjectives it is common (休みならよかったのに).
issues.action: Restricted the ban to verb + なら and added the noun / な-adjective exception.

issues.problem: cd-regret contrast 'と / なら' said regret is built only on ば or たら, false for nouns (日曜日ならよかったのに).
issues.action: Limited the claim to verbs and noted the なら = ば-form of だ case.

issues.problem: cd-regret mistake note for 知ったら、教えました was vague about what the bad sentence means.
issues.action: Rewrote note: it reads as a real past sequence; counterfactual needs ていたら + のに.

issues.problem: Q3 said ば is out for any real past event; ば is fine for past habits (暇があれば本を読んだ), so mechanical use would mislead.
issues.action: Narrowed to a single past event and added the habit exception.

issues.problem: Contrast 'ば vs たら' used 終われば帰って as wrong; with a different subject (仕事が終われば帰っていい) ば is acceptable.
issues.action: Replaced with 着けば電話して ✗ / 着いたら電話して ✓.

issues.problem: Mistake 東京に行ったら、新幹線の切符を予約したほうがいい is not plainly wrong (booking a shinkansen once in Tokyo is a valid reading).
issues.action: Replaced with 海外に行ったら、出発前にパスポートを確認してね ✗ / 行くなら ✓, where 出発前 forces B before A.
